query: How smoothly does the Google Pixel 3a XL run everyday apps, and what lag or freezing do owners experience?
search_text: How smoothly does the run everyday apps, and what lag or freezing do owners experience?

rows.text: Before this, I had the Galaxy a50. It was a decent phone, but as I tend to do a lot of gaming, it couldn't handle most games. This phone can handle almost any game without lag or drop in frame rate. Gaming does make the battery die a little faster, but not a horrible difference. Overall I'd definitely recommend this phone. I didn't have enough to get a newer model of the Pixel, but I'm more than satisfied with this one. I had the pixel 1, but it doesn't compare to this one. It's an amazing deal for the price.

Quality Midrange Phone. Everything from the unboxing to setup was smooth. The Pixel 3a XL or any pixel phone is a high quality and affordable choice with excellent performance. No need to blow money on flagship phone.

This is the best phone I've ever owned. This is actually our 3rd Pixel 3A XL in the household. I got one, my wife wanted one, our son wanted one. It takes the best pictures of any phone I've ever had and my only gripe about it is that there's a bit of a lag when trying to unlock it, rotate it, open the camera, and pop into portrait mode when my kids are doing something adorable. It's otherwise nearly perfect. Pros: no stupid notch or pinhole in the screen, fingerprint reader (located on the rear) works great, screen is fantastic, photos are amazing, custom ROMs are fully supported Cons: small internal storage size and no expansion slot Another con, which is a stock Android issue, is that you can't get rid of the Google search bar on every screen and you can't change the search provider. Hence, the custom ROM.

Really solid phone, glad I got it.. First and foremost, I'd like to mention that mine came from SoonerSoft Electronics, and wow, do they know how to refurbish a phone! When it arrived, the phone looked brand new! I mostly got it to run Calyx OS, so I can't say much about the default experience out of the box because I changed the OS immediately, which took about 5-10 minutes. The device has been fantastic for day-to-day use! The battery is smaller than other phones I've used, but it lasts at least two days and recharges quickly, which is useful if I ever use the phone a lot.

Very good value.. I had a Google 3a that had an accident so I needed a replacement. None of the phones out there motivated to get something new so I decided to go this route and I don't regret it. First off cuddos to the retailer because the phone was in good condition. Second, this is the reason I love everything Google. The transition was smooth and seamless. I can easily see me keeping the phone for a year at least. Keep in mind that since it's realease Google has had on the market the 4, 4a, 5, 5a w/5g, 6 and 6pro. In terms of the phone, it's not spectacular but it does a lot of things very well. My only gripe has nothing to do with the translator the phone itself but with the whole TMobile / Sprint merge.

Favorite phone I've ever had!. This is an excellent phone for the price - early updates from Google and a stock Android experience. The phone is snappy and responsive with a good battery and a great camera! 2 of my friends and I got this phone a few months ago when it was on sale and I'm always going with pixel phones from now on!
Good for the money. Best phone I've ever owned. Suggest adding app locks. To lock the button from moving.

Do not buy refurbished phones. [[VIDEOID:2a0ad3a487f96c30e5ffa0f360504b8]] I had a pixel 3axl that I loved, had it for years... then the screen broke. I decided to "save money" by buying a refurbished phone to replace it. Big mistake! I bought this thing and within days it began to freeze up, randomly crash, and was not reliable at all. People... please share yourselves the disappointment and just buy new. Thank you. I give this -10 stars.
Nice phone. I like the plastic actually, which makes the phone very lightweight. The original Android system runs very well, does not have any bloatware.
A bit slow, but fun to use. A solid google phone for its fan

Great price on like-new google 3a xl. This is the second Google Pixel 3a XL I have purchased from havearly.com through Amazon. Loved my first one so much I bought a second for my wife. Both phones were in perfect, like-new condition and functioned like new. They came with Android 11 and are supposedly getting Android 12. Great experience all the way around! Highly recommend Havearly and Amazon refurbished.

Decent phone for gift. Bought the phone as a gift and their setup was easy. The box was questionable, but the phone came safe and sound. So far, the phone is running smoothly and the screen had no noticeable scratches. The battery seems good, it holds its charge for a long time. The cameras are working well for both photos and videos.

great phone for Ubuntu Touch otherwise no longer supported with Android updates. If you want a phone to run Ubuntu Touch (ubports) then this is one of the best that is still available. You have to find a amazon reseller that is willing to go through their phones and find one that is not OEM locked (ie: did not originally get purchased through Verizon). Since Android support has ended and there are no more security updates coming its a bad idea to continue to run Android on this phone. I also have a pixel 3a that is still going strong but the screen cracked long ago. So longevity is good but screen can crack.

Fast phone for the price some bloat ware. I have used Motorola Droid Max and G Force Both very good phones. The Pixel 3a XL is faster and works better using the internet, may cost a little more worth the extra cost. Get one.

Great so far!. I've not had luck with refurbished products in the past, so I was nervous getting this, but it was really the only phone I could afford. All that being said so far this thing seems great. Fast. Long battery life. Looks absolutely brand new. Never would've known it was pre-used. I really enjoy this phone after 4 days of use. Amazon guarantees this for 90 days which provides some relief if anything happens. And the company I bought it from says they'll guarantee for a full year if I write this honest review. If anything changes with the phone or if I need to return for any reason I'll update this to let you know how the warranty offers and return processes are.

Great all around. Ok... They are the ONLY ones I'll be buying phones from for now on. I had questions so I emailed them and not long after they replied and assured my question. And my product is in awesome condition. it's got scratches on the back NOTHING SERIOUS. No screen scratches or any performance problems. !EVERYTHING WORKS WELL! and amazing customer service. Also. ! IT IS UNLOCKED unlocked ! TO ALL CARRIERS.

One of the reasons why I like the pixel 3axl so much is the battery. It charges quick and depending on how much I use it I can go a full day without charging it again. So far the phone that I received charges very very slow no matter what charger I use, and the battery seems to be less than desirable. I charged it up to 100% yesterday before I went to bed and by the time I woke up it was on 4%. Then I plugged it in up to 100% and less than an hour later it's already below 80% without me even touching it. I will update more in a couple of days... I might need to return it just on the battery alone

Not an UNLOCKED phone!!!. The phone is locked to the Verizon network! My old phone died with 4 months of service left on my Mint mobile SIM, so four months of prepaid service down the drain. Instead of wasting precious time with Amazon/Verizon customer service, I switched to Visible and got the phone up and running within 15 minutes after receiving the SIM card.

No water resistance Careful not dropping it in a pool or toiliet 9. Has mid teir processer: Snapdragon 670 with 4GB RAM. Good enough for casual use. If you play a lot of mobile games or multitask with duel screens, you may see notice some slowdown if you're used to high end smart phones. 10. More carriers selling phone. Original only sold at Verizon Like other Pixel, Google phones; it is an unlocked phone so can use it on any carrier. 11. Missing 3rd mic Lower audio pickup and noise reduction 12. Larger size physcially than Pixel 3 despite it having lower specs 13. Screen Has OLED screen vs LCD like the original, but not as bright. Has dragon trail glass vs gorillia glass. Both are different manufactures with different names. Durablity should be almost the same 14.

Best phone I've had.. Pure Android. Already received an update that I wouldn't get until sometime next year on my old LG or Samsung phones. Fast. No bloat-ware. Best phone I've had. Nothing but Google for me from now on.
